svg.title: Cluster throughput from 1 to 10 nodes, no message lost at any point
svg.desc: Columns of the cluster's msg/s at their number of nodes, on a linear axis, 1, 3, 10, one panel per workload. The green part is the highest step carried at p99 ≤ 1 s; a yellow cap reaches the maximum lossless step when it ran at p99 ≤ 5 s, a red cap when it ran above; the dotted line is the 3-node rate per node times the number of nodes. Durable QoS 1, 1 nodes: 92.9k msg/s per node lossless, 92,900 msg/s in total (maximum lossless; ack p99 744 ms; 1 copy, fsync only); Durable QoS 1, 3 nodes: 39.3k msg/s per node lossless, 117,800 msg/s in total (maximum lossless; ack p99 1.35 s); 114,200 msg/s at p99 ≤ 1 s (ack p99 708 ms); Durable QoS 1, 10 nodes: 29.2k msg/s per node lossless, 292,200 msg/s in total (maximum lossless; ack p99 1.37 s); 228,000 msg/s at p99 ≤ 1 s (ack p99 59 ms); QoS 1, clean sessions, 1 nodes: 114k msg/s per node lossless, 114,000 msg/s in total (maximum lossless; ack p99 315 ms); QoS 1, clean sessions, 3 nodes: 90.3k msg/s per node lossless, 270,800 msg/s in total (maximum lossless; ack p99 3.31 s); 152,000 msg/s at p99 ≤ 1 s (ack p99 67 ms); QoS 1, clean sessions, 10 nodes: 87.6k msg/s per node lossless, 875,900 msg/s in total (maximum lossless; ack p99 4.54 s); 303,800 msg/s at p99 ≤ 1 s (ack p99 85 ms); QoS 0, 1 nodes: 123k msg/s per node lossless, 123,100 msg/s in total (maximum lossless; end-to-end p99 136 ms); QoS 0, 3 nodes: 113k msg/s per node lossless, 340,300 msg/s in total (maximum lossless; end-to-end p99 2.52 s); 253,200 msg/s at p99 ≤ 1 s (end-to-end p99 547 ms); QoS 0, 10 nodes: 97.3k msg/s per node lossless, 973,200 msg/s in total (maximum lossless; end-to-end p99 4.49 s); 506,300 msg/s at p99 ≤ 1 s (end-to-end p99 395 ms).
svg.text: Cluster throughput from 1 to 10 nodes, no message lost at any point
cluster msg/s from the brokers' own counters · 4-vCPU nodes · 3 rounds a step · main 9520b33 and edfdb49, 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28
p99 is the ack latency for QoS 1 and the end-to-end latency for QoS 0, the mean of the rounds
linear: the 3-node rate per node × nodes
ack after fsync + a quorum copy · 1 node keeps one copy
the 10-node maximum lossless as a share of the 3-node rate × 10
Durable QoS 1 falls furthest: at 10 nodes more of each message's
replication and forwarding crosses between nodes.
Hetzner CCX23 brokers (4 vCPU) · CCX33 load generators, calibrated before the ladder · $share, one member per broker, 200 B · 60 s windows
